app_fee.value: CAD 150 per program, non-refundable, paid by credit or debit card.
app_fee.quote: Have a valid credit card or debit card ready for the application fee ($150 CAD).

fee_waiver.value: McMaster does not waive the graduate application fee; departments say they cannot waive it either.
fee_waiver.quote: The university does not waive application fees.

also.quote: We cannot waive the application fee for any reason.

gre_general.value: No university-wide GRE rule; individual programs may ask for GRE scores (see each program).
gre_general.quote: Departments or programs may establish additional requirements, such as scores on the Graduate Record Examination (GRE)

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 92 in most Faculties (Engineering accepts 88; programs may set higher). For tests taken after January 2026 the new-scale minimum is 4.5.
toefl_min.quote: In most Faculties a minimum of 92 IBT (internet-based test) is required. | For tests taken after January 2026, a minimum overall score of 4.5 overall is required.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each band.
ielts_min.quote: Students taking the IELTS are required to achieve a minimum score of 6.5 with a minimum score of 5.5 in each category.

english_waiver.value: Each graduate program may exempt applicants whose university degree was taught in English; the application asks whether your degree's language of instruction and evaluation was English. Check the program's rule.
english_waiver.quote: At the discretion of the graduate program, applicants may be exempted from this requirement if they have completed a university degree at which English is the language of instruction.

also.quote: In the application, indicate whether you have completed a degree where the official language of instruction and evaluation is in English by choosing Yes or No.

notes: Faculty of Engineering sets TOEFL 88 and exempts English-medium degree holders; see engineering program records.
